title: Ultra X event FAQ — deferral, refund and entry transfer policy (sibling official event page)
publisher: Ultra X (organiser; FAQ mirrored on a sibling event site)
claims: Entries cannot be transferred to another participant.
There is no cash refund; if a runner defers to the next edition, the organiser issues an event credit minus the non-refundable deposit, valid for the next year's event.
Deferral is allowed once; the deferment deadline for the 2026 entry was 1 December 2026, 17:00 BST; after that date the entry is non-deferrable and non-refundable.
Entry fees are paid by a non-refundable deposit plus monthly instalments; the participant declaration and terms must be accepted before entering.
